tables.description:
Real NYC 311 government service request data (2022-2024). Each row is one complaint or service request filed by a New York City resident. Contains 500,000 records. All data lives in this single table — no joins needed.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- unique_key: integer primary key for each complaint
- created_date: when the complaint was filed (TEXT, ISO format e.g. '2023-04-15T10:30:00.000'). Use STRFTIME('%Y', created_date) for year, STRFTIME('%m', created_date) for month, STRFTIME('%w', created_date) for day-of-week (0=Sunday, 6=Saturday)
- closed_date: when the complaint was resolved (NULL if still open)
- agency: short code for the handling agency (e.g. 'NYPD', 'HPD', 'DSNY', 'DOT', 'DEP', 'DPR', 'DOB')
- agency_name: full agency name (e.g. 'New York City Police Department', 'Department of Housing Preservation and Development')
- complaint_type: category of the complaint (e.g. 'Noise - Residential', 'HEAT/HOT WATER', 'Illegal Parking', 'Blocked Driveway', 'Street Condition', 'Rodent', 'Graffiti', 'Street Light Condition', 'Sanitation Condition')
- descriptor: sub-category of complaint (e.g. 'Loud Music/Party', 'Banging/Pounding', 'Loud Talking', 'Heat', 'Hot Water')
- location_type: type of location (e.g. 'Street/Sidewalk', 'Residential Building/House', 'Store/Commercial')
- borough: NYC borough in ALL CAPS — 'BROOKLYN', 'MANHATTAN', 'QUEENS', 'BRONX', 'STATEN ISLAND', 'Unspecified'
- city: city name (for complaints outside the 5 boroughs, e.g. 'JAMAICA', 'FLUSHING', 'BRONX')
- status: current status — 'Open', 'Closed', 'Pending', 'In Progress', 'Assigned'
- resolution_description: free-text description of how the complaint was resolved
- latitude, longitude: geographic coordinates (REAL)
- resolution_action_updated_date: last time the resolution status was updated

COMMON QUERY PATTERNS (SQLite):
- Resolution time in days: JULIANDAY(closed_date) - JULIANDAY(created_date)
- Open complaints: status = 'Open' OR closed_date IS NULL
- Filter by year: STRFTIME('%Y', created_date) = '2023'
- Filter by month range: STRFTIME('%Y-%m', created_date) BETWEEN '2023-06' AND '2023-08'
- Weekend complaints: STRFTIME('%w', created_date) IN ('0', '6')
- Weekday complaints: STRFTIME('%w', created_date) NOT IN ('0', '6')
- Within 7 days: (JULIANDAY(closed_date) - JULIANDAY(created_date)) <= 7

SAMPLE QUESTIONS THIS TABLE ANSWERS:
- How many complaints were filed in Brooklyn in 2023?
- Which borough has the highest number of noise complaints?
- What is the average resolution time in days for each borough?
- Which agency handles the most service requests?
- What percentage of complaints were resolved within 7 days?
- Show complaints filed on weekends vs weekdays
